key_insight: BrReMark adds explicit region marking and verification to brain MRI diagnosis, making model reasoning more grounded and less likely to hallucinate findings.
clinical_relevance: This approach could improve the auditability and trustworthiness of MRI AI by showing which brain regions support a diagnosis, especially for unusual or out-of-distribution cases.
method: Generate a hypothesis about a possible abnormality
Ground the hypothesis with explicit ROI bounding-box marking
Re-examine the marked evidence using supervised reasoning and reinforcement learning
Use domain-randomized synthetic pathology data to improve OOD robustness
evidence_signal: On the internal benchmark, BrReMark improved mAP50 to 37.54% from 0.74% and reached 21.57% Clinical F1 and 45.26% diagnostic accuracy; on NOVA OOD data it reduced false positives by 45.7% versus the state of the art.
watch_item: The method depends on accurate ROI localization and synthesized training data, so performance may drop if marking quality or pathology realism is poor.
paper_title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
